listing.name: Independent Interstellar
listing.summary: Adds more-militarized weapons of pirate mk2 ships, and a couple "what-if?" weapons. Not balanced and i didn't even attempt.
listing.aiSummary: Adds militarized variants of pirate Mk2 ships as Independent vessels, along with new weapon variants and hullmods.

description: Introduces Atlas Mk2, Colossus Mk3, and Mudskipper Mk2 as Independent ships with higher armor and OP but reduced storage and acceleration. Adds specialized weapon variants for the Devastator, Hellbore, Plasma Cannon, and HAG. Includes new hullmods such as High Spectral Amplifier, Auxiliary Ablative Armor, Rapid Phase Coils, Advanced Weapon Support, and Jury-rigged Shield Generator.
